//: The Desk's own messages: code -> English template (Python str.format). The server and the engine send the English text and, beside it, {code, params}; the screens show each code in the language chosen (tools/desk/static/strings.js has every code, in English and Marathi). The English here is the text as it was: never change it without changing the tests (tools/desk/test/test_messages.py).
m.edit.stale: this page was changed in another window or tab; it is shown again as it is now
m.edit.notNumber: a position or size is not a number
m.edit.cropBad: a photo crop must give the photo's id, a focus point (two numbers) and a zoom (a number)
m.edit.cropFloor: a photo crop would print below the photo's resolution floor
m.edit.cropLost: the photo of {name} could not be found on the page to crop it: nothing was changed
m.edit.photoDamaged: the photo of {name} is damaged (its raster has the wrong size)
m.edit.lockBool: a story's lock must be true or false
m.edit.treatmentBad: this paper's house style has no such story treatment
m.edit.lockedMove: {name} is locked: unlock it (Shift+L) to move it
m.edit.lockedTake: {name} is locked: unlock it (Shift+L) to take it off the page
m.edit.lockedThere: {name} is locked on page {page}: unlock it there to bring it here
m.edit.saveHeld: this page cannot be saved yet: {name} is also on page {page}, locked there. Unlock it on page {page}, or take it off this page, then save
m.edit.allLocked: every story on this page is locked: unlock one to try another layout
m.edit.noFillAround: no other layout fills the space around the locked stories exactly: unlock one, or move it
m.edit.noFill: no other layout fills this page exactly with these stories
m.edit.noStories: this page has no stories to lay out
m.edit.tooMany: this page has {n} stories; another layout needs {max} or fewer
m.edit.tooManyFree: this page has {n} stories not locked; another layout needs {max} or fewer
m.edit.notAllPlaced: another layout did not place every story of this page; the page is kept as it was
m.edit.moveSamePage: {name} is on this page already: choose another page
m.edit.moveNotLaidOut: page {page} was not laid out in this layout: a story cannot move there
m.edit.moveLockedThere: {name} is also on page {page}, locked there: unlock it there to move it
m.edit.moveCannotSet: {name} cannot be set {w} {cols} wide on page {page}: change its width here, then move it
m.edit.moveNoRoom: there is no free place on page {page} for {name} ({w} {cols} × {h:g} mm): make room there, or narrow it here, then move it
m.edit.notOpen: this page is not open: open it again
m.edit.engineFailed: something went wrong in the engine
m.move.whichPage: Say which page to move the story to, as a page number.
m.move.samePage: The story is on this page already: choose another page.
m.move.notLaidOut: Page {page} was not laid out in this layout: a story cannot move there.
m.save.notChanged: The page could not be changed: {reason}.
m.save.engineNotStarted: The page editor's engine did not start: {why}
m.save.engineNotStartedLog: The page editor's engine did not start. See edit-service.log in the desk home.
m.save.engineStopped: The page editor's engine stopped. Try again.
m.save.engineSlow: The page editor's engine stopped or took too long. Try again.
m.save.unfinished: The last save of this page did not finish: save it again.
m.save.movedHere: A story was moved here from page {page}: check its place and save the page.
m.save.taking: Page {page} is taking a story from this page: when page {page} has been saved, open this page, fill the space and save it.
m.save.movedFrom: A story moved from this page to page {page}: open it, fill the space and save it.
m.save.filesNotFinished: The page was saved, but its files could not be finished.
m.save.heldUnreadable: This page cannot be saved yet: the engine's list of its stories locked on other pages cannot be read.
m.save.held: This page cannot be saved yet: {name} is also on page {page}, locked there. Unlock it on page {page}, or take it off this page, then save.
m.save.heldMore1: 1 more story on this page is locked on another page too.
m.save.heldMoreN: {n} more stories on this page are locked on another page too.
m.save.notPlacedEdited: Taken off the pages in the editor, or moved to a page not saved yet: bring it back onto a page, or save the page it moved to.
m.save.deletedAfter: Deleted from the edition after the layout.
m.press.olderDesk: This page was made by an older version of the Desk, which did not record what its PDF prints: lay the edition out again.
m.press.olderRecord: This page was made by an older version of the Desk, which recorded what its PDF prints in another way: open it in the page editor and save it (or lay out again).
m.press.damaged: This page could not be checked against the edition (a file of the layout or the edition cannot be read): put the file back from a backup, or lay the edition out again.
m.press.pagesChanged: The edition now has {now} pages; this layout has {then}: lay the edition out again.
m.press.backAdsOn: Back-page ads were switched on after this layout: lay the edition out again.
m.press.backAdsOff: Back-page ads were switched off after this layout: lay the edition out again.
m.press.changed1: An article on this page was changed since the page's PDF was made: open the page and save it (Save page sets the current text first).
m.press.changedN: {n} articles on this page were changed since the page's PDF was made: open the page and save it (Save page sets the current text first).
m.press.gone1: An article on this page was deleted from the edition: open the page and save it (Save page takes it off first).
m.press.goneN: {n} articles on this page were deleted from the edition: open the page and save it (Save page takes them off first).
m.press.folio: The volume, issue or price changed: open the page and save it.
m.press.ad: An advertisement on this page changed: open the page and save it (Save page sets the new one first).
m.warn.issueNotSet: Issue number (अंक) not set in step 1: the front page keeps the old number
m.warn.issueNotSetNone: Issue number not set in step 1: the front page prints none
m.warn.outside: a story is outside the news area or over an advertisement
m.warn.overset: {n} lines of text did not fit
m.warn.unsetN: {n} paragraphs could not be set (a character the stand-in fonts lack)
m.warn.unset: paragraphs could not be set (a character the stand-in fonts lack)
m.warn.touch: two lines of a story touch in ink somewhere: check the page
m.warn.emptyArea: About {n} cm² of the news area is left empty: add a short item or a photo
m.warn.notFill: These stories do not fill the page exactly; the layout may fail
m.warn.emptyFoot: About {mm} mm of the page is left empty at the foot — add a short item or a photo
m.warn.charRemoved: {what}: removed a character the fonts do not have (U+{code:04X})
m.warn.sameHeadline: Same headline as another article ({article}) — is it the same story twice?
m.warn.photoSmall: Photo too small to print even one column wide ({px} pixels across) — the story runs without it
m.run.noArticles: No articles with a headline and body text
m.run.choosing: Choosing the stories for each page
m.run.noStoriesLeft: No stories left for this page
m.run.someFailed: {failed} of {total} pages could not be laid out
m.run.tooManyModules: {n} modules: more than the layout search takes ({max})
m.run.outOfTime: the layout search ran out of time
m.run.notFillExactly: these stories do not fill the page exactly
m.run.restarted: The server was restarted while this run was in progress. Start it again.
m.run.waiting: Waiting for another edition's pages to finish.
m.run.editionChanged: Set aside: the edition's date or pages changed after this layout. Lay it out again.
m.run.engineNotStarted: The layout engine could not be started: {error}.
m.run.putting: Putting the edition PDF and the press files together…
m.run.noPages: The layout engine finished but made no pages.
m.run.notMerged: The pages were made, but they could not be put into one file.
m.run.checking: Checking every page with the independent PDF/X-1a checker…
m.run.madeFailed: {n} could not be made: see the notes on those pages.
m.run.checkProblems: The PDF/X-1a check found problems in {files}: do not send those to the press.
m.run.noArticlesYet: There are no articles in this edition yet.
m.run.alreadyRunning: Pages for this edition are already being made. Wait for them, or cancel that run first.
m.plan.needsText: It needs a headline and some body text
m.plan.headlineTooLong: Its headline is too long to set (at most four lines) — shorten the headline
m.plan.tooLong: Too long for a whole page — shorten it
m.plan.noRoom: No room left — add pages, lower another story's priority, or pin it to a page
m.plan.pinnedFull: More than {max} stories are pinned to page {page} — pin it to another page
m.plan.noRoomOnPage: No room on page {page} — it waits: pin it to another page, or shorten the page's stories
m.plan.pageFailed: Page {n} could not be laid out: {message}
m.store.dateFormat: Give the edition's date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-21.
m.store.pageRange: The page must be empty (the Desk chooses) or a page number from 1 to {pages}.
m.store.tooManyEditions: There are too many editions for this date.
m.store.dateFixed: The date of an edition cannot be changed. Make a new edition for the other date.
m.store.deleteRunning: Pages for this edition are being made. Cancel that first, then delete it.
m.store.deleteSaving: A page of this edition is being changed or saved. Wait a moment, then delete it.
m.store.adBusy: Ads cannot be changed while the pages are being made. Wait until that finishes, or cancel it.
m.store.wordNone: No story in this Word file could be added: {reasons}
m.store.wordNoneBare: No story in this Word file could be added.
m.store.pasteNone: No articles were found. Put each article's headline on its first line, its text below it, and a line with only --- between articles.
m.store.pasteParts: {n} part(s) had a headline but no text.
m.img.tooManyPixels: This picture has too many pixels for the Desk. Save it smaller and try again.
m.img.notAPicture: This file is not a picture the Desk can read. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
m.img.format: This picture is a {fmt} file. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
m.img.damaged: The picture file is damaged or incomplete. Try saving it again.
m.img.tooLarge: This picture file is larger than 40 MB. Save it smaller and try again.
m.img.noProfile: Photos cannot be converted for print: the newsprint colour profile is missing. Put it at ~/PageinatorPrivate/icc/ or set PAGEINATOR_ICC to its file.
m.img.badProfile: The newsprint colour profile could not be used: it must be a CMYK printer profile ({error}).
m.bundle.notZip: This is not a Pageinator stories file (a .zip made by Pageinator). Download it again from Pageinator and try again.
m.bundle.damaged: This Pageinator stories file is damaged. Download it again and try again.
m.bundle.tooLarge: This Pageinator stories file is larger than 200 MB.
m.bundle.unpacksTooLarge: This Pageinator stories file unpacks to more than 300 MB.
m.bundle.tooManyFiles: This Pageinator stories file holds more than {max} files.
m.bundle.memberTooLarge: {name} in this Pageinator stories file is larger than the Desk takes.
m.bundle.packed: {name} in this Pageinator stories file unpacks to far more than its packed size: the file was refused.
m.bundle.badMember: This Pageinator stories file holds {name}, which such a file never holds: the file was refused.
m.bundle.noJson: This file has no bundle.json: it is not a Pageinator stories file.
m.bundle.badJson: The bundle.json in this file cannot be read.
m.bundle.version: This Pageinator stories file is in a format this Desk does not read ({format}): update the Desk, or make the file again.
m.bundle.unknownField: This Pageinator stories file has a field this Desk does not know ({field}): update the Desk, or make the file again.
m.bundle.badField: This Pageinator stories file has a field that is missing or not valid ({field}).
m.bundle.tooManyStories: This Pageinator stories file holds more than {max} stories.
m.bundle.storyTwice: This Pageinator stories file lists the story {story} twice.
m.bundle.photoMissing: A photo the stories name is not in this Pageinator stories file ({name}).
m.bundle.badSha: A photo in this Pageinator stories file does not match its SHA-256 checksum ({name}): the file was changed or damaged. Download it again.
m.bundle.otherDate: These stories are for the edition of {date}; this edition is of {edition}. Open that edition, or make the file again.
m.bundle.otherPages: The stories were sent for an edition of {sent} pages; this one has {pages}: a story pinned to a page it does not have was refused.
m.bundle.keptEdited: Changed in the Desk since it was imported: kept as it is.
m.bundle.keptNewer: The Desk has a newer revision of it (revision {revision}): kept as it is.
m.bundle.retry: It changed in the Desk while the file was being read: import the file again.
m.bundle.zip64: This Pageinator stories file is in the ZIP64 form, which the Desk does not take: make the file again.
m.bundle.deletedInDesk: Deleted in the Desk after it was imported: not added again.
m.docx.overSize: This Word file is larger than 20 MB.
m.docx.protected: This Word file is protected with a password, or is an old .doc file: save it as .docx without a password and try again.
m.docx.tooLarge: This Word file is too large to read.
m.docx.damaged: This Word file is damaged. Save it again and try again.
m.docx.notWord: This is not a Word (.docx) file. Save it as .docx and try again.
m.docx.noStory: No story was found in this Word file: it needs a headline and some text.
m.docx.tooManyStories: This file holds more than {max} stories; only the first {max} were imported.
m.docx.emptyHeading1: 1 heading had no text under it and was not imported.
m.docx.emptyHeadingsN: {n} headings had no text under them and were not imported.
m.docx.table1: 1 table was not imported: copy its text into the article if it is needed.
m.docx.tablesN: {n} tables were not imported: copy their text into the article if it is needed.
m.docx.picture1: 1 picture was not imported: add photos in the Desk.
m.docx.picturesN: {n} pictures were not imported: add photos in the Desk.
m.docx.formatting: Formatting (bold, italic, sizes) is not kept: the Desk sets the type.
m.bundle.adMissing: An ad the file names is not in this Pageinator stories file ({name}).
m.bundle.adNoSlot: The pages of this edition have no ad space called {slot}.
m.bundle.adKept: The ad space {slot} has other artwork in the Desk: kept as it is. Remove it in the Desk and import the file again to take the file's.
m.bundle.adRefused: The ad for {slot} was not added. {reason}
m.bundle.keptVolume: The file's volume is “{sent}”; this edition's is “{desk}”: the Desk's is kept. If the file's is right, change it in this edition's settings.
m.bundle.keptIssue: The file's issue number is “{sent}”; this edition's is “{desk}”: the Desk's is kept. If the file's is right, change it in this edition's settings.
m.bundle.keptPrice: The file's price is “{sent}”; this edition's is “{desk}”: the Desk's is kept. If the file's is right, change it in this edition's settings.
m.bundle.backAdsOn: The stories were sent for an edition with back-page ads; this one has none: to take the file's ads, tick “Back page has ads” in this edition's settings and import the file again.
m.bundle.backAdsOff: The stories were sent for an edition without back-page ads; this one has them: untick “Back page has ads” in this edition's settings if its last page is all news.
m.bundle.adNotInFile: The ad in {slot} is in the Desk but not in this file (the hosted edition no longer has it): remove it in the Desk if it should not print.
